bullets.title: Welcome to GNPS Program 6
bullets.text: Supporting Mothers and Newborns Welcome to the highest level of the GNPS learning pathway. Global Nursing Professionals improve maternal and newborn outcomes beyond the individual bedside. They lead safety initiatives, strengthen referral systems, mentor staff, use data and support equitable access to respectful maternity care. This level develops advanced capability in maternal-newborn leadership…

bullets.title: Leading Respectful and Safe Maternity Services
bullets.text: Leadership in maternal and newborn care means creating services where women and families are treated with dignity, staff can raise concerns and evidence-based care is available reliably. Global Nursing Professionals model respectful practice and strengthen clinical governance.

bullets.title: Improving Maternal and Neonatal Safety Systems
bullets.text: Preventable maternal and newborn harm often involves delayed recognition, communication failure or weak referral pathways. Systems thinking helps leaders understand how work conditions influence outcomes.

bullets.title: Quality Improvement and Evidence Translation
bullets.text: Global Nursing Professionals use data and evidence to improve antenatal, intrapartum, postnatal and newborn outcomes. Improvement should be specific, practical and evaluated over time.

bullets.title: Digital Maternity Care and Global Maternal-Newborn Health
bullets.text: Digital records, remote monitoring, telehealth and decision-support tools can improve maternity care, but they can also create privacy, access and automation risks. Global Nursing Professionals use technology critically while addressing wider maternal and newborn inequities.
